subject: general
question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If W % D # G @ B & M @ I, then how is D related to M?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

Given statement :- W % D # G @ B & M @ I

So,

 
• W % D → W is the wife of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6ec145a2fe706b45dca26c8204aafddd4fc538deb07a8fdbe549975197878c3.png] 

 
• D # G → D is the brother of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c371ba983e5232161dde5adab4c2a32ab607bbd21f687a51185e16ef940339d.png] 

 
• G @ B → G is the daughter of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af120ca19d4517ee74c72e49fcc496b6bfe89b3c1d88827c28717e0666f59b84.png] 

 
• B & M → B is the husband of M.

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6463b3e407bc571c0cbd23ce15e59b64002f614cb537141d74114e6dcf9880f9.png] 

 
• M @ I → M is the daughter of I.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24306ea25cd090f7bfe7536e3e6bd81c9f4f565879d72426687dacbbba15f9c6.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree D is the son of M.

Hence, "**Son**" is the correct answer.
